+++ game/scripts/snake_controller.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,141 @@
+extends Node2D
+class_name SnakeController
+
+signal ate_orb
+signal died
+
+const TILE_SIZE: int = 32
+
+var game_manager: Node = null
+var segments: Array = [] # Array of Vector2 grid positions, head at index 0
+var segment_nodes: Array = []
+var direction: Vector2 = Vector2.RIGHT
+var move_timer: Timer
+var speed_level: int = 1
+var move_interval: float = 0.18
+var pending_grow: int = 0
+
+func _init():
+    pass
+
+func setup(gm: Node) -> void:
+    game_manager = gm
+    # create timer
+    move_timer = Timer.new()
+    move_timer.one_shot = false
+    move_timer.wait_time = move_interval
+    add_child(move_timer)
+    move_timer.connect("timeout", Callable(self, "_on_move_timer"))
+    move_timer.start()
+    # initial snake: 3 segments in center
+    segments.clear()
+    segment_nodes.clear()
+    var start = Vector2(5,5)
+    segments.append(start)
+    segments.append(start - Vector2(1,0))
+    segments.append(start - Vector2(2,0))
+
+    # visual nodes: simple ColorRect style via Sprite2D created here
+    _rebuild_visuals()
+
+func _rebuild_visuals() -> void:
+    for n in segment_nodes:
+        if is_instance_valid(n):
+            n.queue_free()
+    segment_nodes.clear()
+    for i in range(segments.size()):
+        var s = Sprite2D.new()
+        s.texture = null
+        s.modulate = Color(0.3,1.0,0.3)
+        s.centered = true
+        s.scale = Vector2(0.9,0.9)
+        add_child(s)
+        segment_nodes.append(s)
+    _update_visuals()
+
+func _update_visuals() -> void:
+    for i in range(segments.size()):
+        var cell = segments[i]
+        var pos = cell * TILE_SIZE + Vector2(TILE_SIZE/2, TILE_SIZE/2)
+        var node = segment_nodes[i]
+        node.position = pos
+        node.z_index = 10 - i
+
+func set_speed_level(level: int) -> void:
+    if level != speed_level:
+        speed_level = level
+        # adjust interval
+        move_interval = max(0.04, 0.18 - (speed_level - 1) * 0.02)
+        if move_timer:
+            move_timer.wait_time = move_interval
+
+func set_direction(dir: Vector2) -> void:
+    # avoid reversing
+    if dir + direction == Vector2.ZERO:
+        return
+    direction = dir
+
+func _on_move_timer() -> void:
+    # read input for direction (keyboard support here for simplicity)
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_up"):
+        set_direction(Vector2(0,-1))
+    elif Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_down"):
+        set_direction(Vector2(0,1))
+    elif Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_left"):
+        set_direction(Vector2(-1,0))
+    elif Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_right"):
+        set_direction(Vector2(1,0))
+
+    var new_head = segments[0] + direction
+    # collision with walls
+    if game_manager and game_manager.is_cell_blocked(new_head):
+        emit_signal("died", "wall")
+        game_manager.on_snake_death("wall")
+        return
+    # collision with self
+    for i in range(1, segments.size()):
+        if segments[i] == new_head:
+            emit_signal("died", "self")
+            game_manager.on_snake_death("self")
+            return
+    # move body
+    segments.insert(0, new_head)
+    if pending_grow > 0:
+        pending_grow -= 1
+    else:
+        segments.pop_back()
+    _update_visuals()
+
+    # check orb
+    if game_manager and game_manager.orb_manager and game_manager.orb_manager.consume_orb_at(new_head):
+        pending_grow += 1
+        emit_signal("ate_orb")
+        if game_manager:
+            game_manager.register_orb_eaten()
+
+func is_occupying_cell(cell: Vector2) -> bool:
+    for c in segments:
+        if c == cell:
+            return true
+    return false
+
+func grow(n: int=1) -> void:
+    pending_grow += n
+
+func reset() -> void:
+    # reset to initial
+    segments.clear()
+    segments.append(Vector2(5,5))
+    segments.append(Vector2(4,5))
+    segments.append(Vector2(3,5))
+    pending_grow = 0
+    direction = Vector2(1,0)
+    set_speed_level(1)
+    _rebuild_visuals()
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+    # slight wobble for body segments (visual only)
+    for i in range(1, segment_nodes.size()):
+        var node = segment_nodes[i]
+        var wobble = sin(OS.get_ticks_msec() / 200.0 + i) * 2.0
+        node.position.y += wobble

+extends Node2D
+class_name OrbManager
+
+const TILE_SIZE: int = 32
+var game_manager: Node = null
+var orbs := {} # map "x,y" -> Dictionary {node, cell}
+
+func setup(gm: Node) -> void:
+    game_manager = gm
+
+func spawn_orb() -> void:
+    if not game_manager:
+        return
+    var cell: Vector2 = game_manager.get_random_free_cell()
+    var key = "%d,%d" % [cell.x, cell.y]
+    if orbs.has(key):
+        return
+    var s := Sprite2D.new()
+    var tex_path := "res://game/assets/orb.png"
+    if ResourceLoader.exists(tex_path):
+        s.texture = load(tex_path)
+    s.centered = true
+    s.position = cell * TILE_SIZE + Vector2(TILE_SIZE/2, TILE_SIZE/2)
+    add_child(s)
+    orbs[key] = {"node": s, "cell": cell}
+
+func has_orb_at(cell: Vector2) -> bool:
+    return orbs.has("%d,%d" % [cell.x, cell.y])
+
+func consume_orb_at(cell: Vector2) -> bool:
+    var key = "%d,%d" % [cell.x, cell.y]
+    if not orbs.has(key):
+        return false
+    var data = orbs[key]
+    var node = data["node"]
+    if is_instance_valid(node):
+        node.queue_free()
+    orbs.erase(key)
+    # spawn particle effect if available
+    var pe_path := "res://game/resources/particle_effects.tscn"
+    if ResourceLoader.exists(pe_path):
+        var pe_res = load(pe_path)
+        if pe_res:
+            var inst = pe_res.instantiate()
+            add_child(inst)
+            inst.global_position = cell * TILE_SIZE + Vector2(TILE_SIZE/2, TILE_SIZE/2)
+            var t = Timer.new()
+            t.one_shot = true
+            t.wait_time = 1.0
+            add_child(t)
+            t.connect("timeout", Callable(inst, "queue_free"))
+            t.start()
+    # spawn another orb after short delay
+    var t2 = Timer.new()
+    t2.one_shot = true
+    t2.wait_time = 0.5
+    add_child(t2)
+    t2.connect("timeout", Callable(self, "spawn_orb"))
+    t2.start()
+    return true
+
+func reset() -> void:
+    for key in orbs.keys():
+        var data = orbs[key]
+        var node = data["node"]
+        if is_instance_valid(node):
+            node.queue_free()
+    orbs.clear()

+extends Node2D
+class_name HazardBallController
+
+const TILE_SIZE: int = 32
+var game_manager: Node = null
+var velocity: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
+
+func setup(gm: Node, initial_velocity: Vector2) -> void:
+    game_manager = gm
+    velocity = initial_velocity
+
+func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
+    if velocity == Vector2.ZERO:
+        return
+    global_position += velocity * delta
+    # bounce against arena rect
+    if not game_manager:
+        return
+    var rect = game_manager.arena_rect_pixels
+    if global_position.x < rect.position.x + 4:
+        global_position.x = rect.position.x + 4
+        velocity.x = -velocity.x
+    elif global_position.x > rect.position.x + rect.size.x - 4:
+        global_position.x = rect.position.x + rect.size.x - 4
+        velocity.x = -velocity.x
+    if global_position.y < rect.position.y + 4:
+        global_position.y = rect.position.y + 4
+        velocity.y = -velocity.y
+    elif global_position.y > rect.position.y + rect.size.y - 4:
+        global_position.y = rect.position.y + rect.size.y - 4
+        velocity.y = -velocity.y
+
+    # check collision with snake head
+    if game_manager and game_manager.snake_controller:
+        var head_pos = game_manager.snake_controller.segments[0] * TILE_SIZE + Vector2(TILE_SIZE/2, TILE_SIZE/2)
+        if head_pos.distance_to(global_position) < TILE_SIZE * 0.6:
+            game_manager.on_snake_death("hazard")

--- game/scripts/game_manager.gd
+++ game/scripts/game_manager.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,240 @@
+extends Node2D
+class_name GameManager
+
+const TILE_SIZE: int = 32
+const ARENA_TILES := Vector2(20, 15) # width x height in tiles
+const ARENA_PIXEL_SIZE := ARENA_TILES * TILE_SIZE
+
+var arena_index: int = 1
+var arena_paths := [
+	"res://game/scenes/arena_1.tscn",
+	"res://game/scenes/arena_2.tscn",
+	"res://game/scenes/arena_3.tscn",
+]
+
+var arena_node: Node = null
+var wall_cells: Array = [] # Array of Vector2 grid cells
+var hazard_nodes: Array = []
+var orb_manager: Node = null
+var snake_controller: Node = null
+var ui_controller: Node = null
+var arena_rect_pixels: Rect2 = Rect2(Vector2(160,60), ARENA_PIXEL_SIZE)
+
+var score: int = 0
+var speed_level: int = 1
+var orbs_eaten: int = 0
+var game_over: bool = false
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	_setup_input()
+
+	# instantiate UI scene if present
+	var ui_path = "res://game/scenes/ui.tscn"
+	if ResourceLoader.exists(ui_path):
+		var ui_res = load(ui_path)
+		if ui_res:
+			var ui = ui_res.instantiate()
+			add_child(ui)
+			if ui.has_method("setup"):
+				ui.setup(self)
+			ui_controller = ui
+
+	# orb manager (script-only class)
+	var orb_script_path = "res://game/scripts/orb_manager.gd"
+	if ResourceLoader.exists(orb_script_path):
+		var orb_cls = load(orb_script_path)
+		if orb_cls:
+			orb_manager = orb_cls.new()
+			add_child(orb_manager)
+			if orb_manager.has_method("setup"):
+				orb_manager.setup(self)
+
+	# snake: prefer script class instance
+	var snake_script_path = "res://game/scripts/snake_controller.gd"
+	if ResourceLoader.exists(snake_script_path):
+		var sc = load(snake_script_path)
+		if sc:
+			snake_controller = sc.new()
+			add_child(snake_controller)
+			if snake_controller.has_method("setup"):
+				snake_controller.setup(self)
+			if snake_controller.has_method("connect"):
+				snake_controller.connect("ate_orb", Callable(self, "_on_snake_ate_orb"))
+				snake_controller.connect("died", Callable(self, "_on_snake_died"))
+
+	_load_arena(arena_index)
+
+	# spawn a couple of starting orbs
+	if orb_manager:
+		for i in range(3):
+			orb_manager.spawn_orb()
+
+	if ui_controller:
+		ui_controller.update_score(score)
+		ui_controller.update_speed(speed_level)
+
+	print("Neon Serpent")
+
+func _setup_input() -> void:
+	var actions = {
+		"move_up": [KEY_W, KEY_UP],
+		"move_down": [KEY_S, KEY_DOWN],
+		"move_left": [KEY_A, KEY_LEFT],
+		"move_right": [KEY_D, KEY_RIGHT],
+		"restart": [KEY_R],
+		"quit": [KEY_ESCAPE],
+	}
+	for name in actions.keys():
+		if not InputMap.has_action(name):
+			InputMap.add_action(name)
+		for code in actions[name]:
+			var ev = InputEventKey.new()
+			ev.physical_keycode = code
+			InputMap.action_add_event(name, ev)
+
+func _load_arena(index: int) -> void:
+	if arena_node and is_instance_valid(arena_node):
+		arena_node.queue_free()
+	for h in hazard_nodes:
+		if is_instance_valid(h):
+			h.queue_free()
+	hazard_nodes.clear()
+	wall_cells.clear()
+
+	var path = arena_paths[(index - 1) % arena_paths.size()]
+	if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
+		var res = load(path)
+		if res:
+			arena_node = res.instantiate()
+			add_child(arena_node)
+			for child in arena_node.get_children():
+				if typeof(child.name) == TYPE_STRING and child.name.begins_with("Wall"):
+					var cell = Vector2(int(child.position.x / TILE_SIZE), int(child.position.y / TILE_SIZE))
+					wall_cells.append(cell)
+				elif typeof(child.name) == TYPE_STRING and child.name.begins_with("HazardSpawn"):
+					# create hazard instance using script if available
+					var hb_script = "res://game/scripts/hazard_ball_controller.gd"
+					if ResourceLoader.exists(hb_script):
+						var hb_cls = load(hb_script)
+						if hb_cls:
+							var hb = hb_cls.new()
+							add_child(hb)
+							var v = Vector2(randf() * 200 - 100, randf() * 200 - 100)
+							if hb.has_method("setup"):
+								hb.setup(self, v)
+							h.global_position = child.global_position
+							hazard_nodes.append(hb)
+						else:
+							var hb_path = "res://game/scenes/hazard_ball.tscn"
+							if ResourceLoader.exists(hb_path):
+								var hb_res = load(hb_path)
+								var hb2 = hb_res.instantiate()
+								add_child(hb2)
+								var v2 = Vector2(randf() * 200 - 100, randf() * 200 - 100)
+								if hb2.has_method("setup"):
+									hb2.setup(self, v2)
+								hb2.global_position = child.global_position
+								hazard_nodes.append(hb2)
+	arena_rect_pixels = Rect2(Vector2(160,60), ARENA_PIXEL_SIZE)
+
+func is_cell_blocked(cell: Vector2) -> bool:
+	if cell.x < 0 or cell.y < 0 or cell.x >= ARENA_TILES.x or cell.y >= ARENA_TILES.y:
+		return true
+	for c in wall_cells:
+		if c == cell:
+			return true
+	return false
+
+func get_random_free_cell() -> Vector2:
+	var tries = 0
+	while tries < 200:
+		var x = randi() % int(ARENA_TILES.x)
+		var y = randi() % int(ARENA_TILES.y)
+		var cell = Vector2(x,y)
+		if is_cell_blocked(cell):
+			tries += 1
+			continue
+		if snake_controller and snake_controller.has_method("is_occupying_cell") and snake_controller.is_occupying_cell(cell):
+			tries += 1
+			continue
+		if orb_manager and orb_manager.has_orb_at(cell):
+			tries += 1
+			continue
+		return cell
+	return Vector2(1,1)
+
+func register_orb_eaten() -> void:
+	score += 10
+	orbs_eaten += 1
+	if ui_controller:
+		ui_controller.update_score(score)
+	if orb_manager:
+		# spawn one immediately; orb_manager also schedules respawn when consumed
+		pass
+	if orbs_eaten % 5 == 0:
+		speed_level += 1
+		if snake_controller and snake_controller.has_method("set_speed_level"):
+			snake_controller.set_speed_level(speed_level)
+		if ui_controller:
+			ui_controller.update_speed(speed_level)
+		_pulse_background()
+	if score >= 100:
+		print("WIN")
+		_advance_arena()
+
+func _pulse_background() -> void:
+	var t = create_tween()
+	t.tween_property(self, "modulate", Color(1.2,1.2,1.2,1), 0.15).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE)
+	t.tween_property(self, "modulate", Color(1,1,1,1), 0.25).set_delay(0.15)
+
+func _advance_arena() -> void:
+	arena_index = (arena_index % arena_paths.size()) + 1
+	score = 0
+	orbs_eaten = 0
+	speed_level = 1
+	if snake_controller and snake_controller.has_method("reset"):
+		snake_controller.reset()
+	if orb_manager and orb_manager.has_method("reset"):
+		orb_manager.reset()
+	_load_arena(arena_index)
+	if orb_manager:
+		for i in range(3):
+			orb_manager.spawn_orb()
+
+func on_snake_death(reason: String) -> void:
+	if game_over:
+		return
+	game_over = true
+	if snake_controller and snake_controller.has_method("pause_movement"):
+		snake_controller.pause_movement()
+	print("GAME OVER")
+	print("Final score: %d" % score)
+	if ui_controller and ui_controller.has_method("show_game_over"):
+		ui_controller.show_game_over(score)
+
+func _on_snake_ate_orb() -> void:
+	register_orb_eaten()
+
+func _on_snake_died(reason: String) -> void:
+	on_snake_death(reason)
+
+func _input(ev) -> void:
+	if game_over:
+		if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
+			game_over = false
+			score = 0
+			orbs_eaten = 0
+			speed_level = 1
+			if snake_controller and snake_controller.has_method("reset"):
+				snake_controller.reset()
+			if orb_manager and orb_manager.has_method("reset"):
+				orb_manager.reset()
+			_load_arena(arena_index)
+			if orb_manager:
+				for i in range(3):
+					orb_manager.spawn_orb()
+			if ui_controller:
+				ui_controller.update_score(score)
+				ui_controller.update_speed(speed_level)
+		elif Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
+			get_tree().quit()

initial_build_notes.text:
Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement indices -> owning files (primary):
  - 0 (title): game/project.godot (application name), game/scripts/game_manager.gd (prints).
  - 1 (input): game/scripts/snake_controller.gd (maps keys -> direction).
  - 2 (tweened movement): game/scripts/snake_controller.gd (uses create_tween to interpolate positions).
  - 3 (wobble segments): game/scripts/snake_controller.gd (segments follow with slight oscillation via tween offsets).
  - 4,5 (orb eat & +10 score): game/scripts/orb_manager.gd and game/scripts/game_manager.gd; snake_controller notifies game_manager to grow and add score.
  - 6 (particles): game/resources/particle_effects.tscn triggered by orb_manager (milestone 2; implemented as simple Particles2D).
  - 7,8 (speed up & background pulse): game/scripts/game_manager.gd (tracks orbs eaten and speed level; pulses CanvasModulate color).
  - 9,10,11 (hazards, hazard death): game/scenes/hazard_ball.tscn and game/scripts/hazard_ball_controller.gd; game_manager checks collisions and ends run.
  - 12,13 (wall and self collision): game/scenes/arena_*.tscn hold wall positions; game/scripts/snake_controller.gd checks collisions and informs game_manager.
  - 14 (death animation): game/resources/particle_effects.tscn and a simple fade/shake in game_manager (secondary milestone).
  - 15 (3 arenas & level progression): game/scenes/arena_1/2/3.tscn and game/scripts/game_manager.gd (loads next).
  - 16 (level designer editable): arenas are full .tscn files with Wall nodes (editable in editor).
  - 17,18,19 (UI, speed display, game over prompt & restart): game/scenes/ui.tscn and game/scripts/ui_controller.gd; game_manager triggers UI changes and prints "GAME OVER" and final score, and handles R/Esc.
  - 20,21 (win at 100 points and advance): game/scripts/game_manager.gd (checks score and advances arena; prints "WIN").

- State ownership and interfaces:
  - GameManager (game/scripts/game_manager.gd) owns global state: score (int), speed_level (int), arena_index (int), wall_cells (Array[Vector2]), arena_size (Vector2 in tiles), references to OrbManager and SnakeController.
    - Interface used by others:
      - game_manager.is_cell_blocked(cell: Vector2) -> bool
      - game_manager.register_orb_eaten(pos: Vector2) -> void
      - game_manager.get_random_free_cell() -> Vector2
      - game_manager.on_snake_death(reason:String) -> void
  - SnakeController (game/scripts/snake_controller.gd) owns snake positions (Array[Vector2] grid coords), movement timer, body segment nodes.
    - Interface:
      - snake.setup(game_manager: Node) -> void
      - snake.reset() -> void
  - OrbManager (game/scripts/orb_manager.gd) owns orb nodes and provides:
    - spawn_orb()
    - get_orb_at(cell:Vector2) -> Node or null
    - consume_orb_at(cell:Vector2) -> bool (returns true if consumed and plays particle)
  - HazardBallController (game/scripts/hazard_ball_controller.gd) owns its velocity and bounces within arena bounds; exposes global_position.

- Coordinate convention:
  - Grid coordinates are integer Vector2(x,y). Pixel position = grid * TILE_SIZE + TILE_SIZE/2 (sprites are centered). TILE_SIZE = 32.

+    if orbs.has(key):

+    return orbs.has("%d,%d" % [cell.x, cell.y])
+
+func consume_orb_at(cell: Vector2) -> bool:
+    var key = "%d,%d" % [cell.x, cell.y]
+    if not orbs.has(key):
+        return false
+    var data = orbs[key]
+    var node = data["node"]
+    if is_instance_valid(node):
+        node.queue_free()
+    orbs.erase(key)

+            t.wait_time = 1.0
+            add_child(t)
+            t.connect("timeout", Callable(inst, "queue_free"))

+    return true

+    for key in orbs.keys():
+        var data = orbs[key]
+        var node = data["node"]
+        if is_instance_valid(node):

+		"move_right": [KEY_D, KEY_RIGHT],

var direction: Vector2 = Vector2.RIGHT

var speed_level: int = 1
var move_interval: float = 0.18
var pending_grow: int = 0

    pass

func setup(gm: Node) -> void:
    game_manager = gm
    # create timer
    move_timer = Timer.new()
    move_timer.one_shot = false
    move_timer.wait_time = move_interval
    add_child(move_timer)
    move_timer.connect("timeout", Callable(self, "_on_move_timer"))
    move_timer.start()
    # initial snake: 3 segments in center
    segments.clear()
    segment_nodes.clear()
    var start = Vector2(5,5)
    segments.append(start)
    segments.append(start - Vector2(1,0))
    segments.append(start - Vector2(2,0))

    # visual nodes: simple ColorRect style via Sprite2D created here
    _rebuild_visuals()

func _rebuild_visuals() -> void:
    for n in segment_nodes:
        if is_instance_valid(n):
            n.queue_free()
    segment_nodes.clear()
    for i in range(segments.size()):
        var s = Sprite2D.new()
        s.texture = null
        s.modulate = Color(0.3,1.0,0.3)
        s.centered = true
        s.scale = Vector2(0.9,0.9)
        add_child(s)
        segment_nodes.append(s)
    _update_visuals()

func _update_visuals() -> void:
    for i in range(segments.size()):
        var cell = segments[i]
        var pos = cell * TILE_SIZE + Vector2(TILE_SIZE/2, TILE_SIZE/2)
        var node = segment_nodes[i]
        node.position = pos
        node.z_index = 10 - i

func set_speed_level(level: int) -> void:
    if level != speed_level:
        speed_level = level
        # adjust interval
        move_interval = max(0.04, 0.18 - (speed_level - 1) * 0.02)
        if move_timer:
            move_timer.wait_time = move_interval

func set_direction(dir: Vector2) -> void:
    # avoid reversing
    if dir + direction == Vector2.ZERO:
        return
    direction = dir

func _on_move_timer() -> void:
    # read input for direction (keyboard support here for simplicity)
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_up"):
        set_direction(Vector2(0,-1))
    elif Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_down"):
        set_direction(Vector2(0,1))
    elif Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_left"):
        set_direction(Vector2(-1,0))
    elif Input.is_action_just_pressed("move_right"):
        set_direction(Vector2(1,0))

        emit_signal("died", "wall")
        game_manager.on_snake_death("wall")
        return
    # collision with self
    for i in range(1, segments.size()):
        if segments[i] == new_head:
            emit_signal("died", "self")
            game_manager.on_snake_death("self")
            return
    # move body
    segments.insert(0, new_head)
    if pending_grow > 0:
        pending_grow -= 1
    else:
        segments.pop_back()
    _update_visuals()

    # check orb
    if game_manager and game_manager.orb_manager and game_manager.orb_manager.consume_orb_at(new_head):
        pending_grow += 1
        emit_signal("ate_orb")
        if game_manager:

    for c in segments:

    pending_grow += n

    segments.append(Vector2(4,5))
    segments.append(Vector2(3,5))
